 Voters elect county executives in Anne Arundel, Baltimore, Harford, Howard counties
 Greg Ng Digital Content Manager BALTIMORE — Refresh this page often for election results covering the four Suburban Baltimore county executive races as they come in to the 11 Newsroom. 
 Anne Arundel, Baltimore and Howard counties are electing new leaders. Harford County's incumbent is running for re-election and faces challengers.
 Advertisement Anne Arundel County Executive 
 This was an open race as Anne Arundel County Executive Steuart Pittman is term-limited, serving out his second four-year term.
 Allison Pickard emerged from a three-way Democratic Primary race to face off against Dave Crawford, who ran unopposed in the Republican Primary.
 There have been 11 county executives who have led Anne Arundel County, eight of whom were Republicans and three were Democrats.
 Baltimore County Executive
 The Baltimore County executive's office was open this election cycle following the County Council's appointment of Kathy Klausmeier in January 2025 to fill out the remaining term upon Johnny Olszewski's election to Congress in 2024 . (The appointment was contingent on a commitment from the candidate to not run for a full term.)
 Julian Jones emerged from a five-way Democratic Primary race and Patrick Dyer won the two-way Republican Primary race.
 There have been been 16 county executives who have led Baltimore County, 14 of whom were Democrats and two were Republicans.
 This was also the first year in which Baltimore County voters decided nine races for the expanded County Council.
 Harford County Executive
 Republican incumbent Bob Cassilly defeated two challengers to face off against Barbara Osborn Kreamer, who won a two-way Democratic Primary race.
 There have been eight county executives who have served Harford County, the first four of which were Democrats and the most recent four were Republicans.
 Howard County Executive 
 This was an open race as Howard County Executive Calvin Ball is term-limited, serving out his second four-year term.
 Vanessa Atterbeary emerged from a four-way Democratic Primary race to face off against Green Party candidate Nater Kane. No Republican candidates ran in the Primary.
 There have been 10 county executives who have led Howard County, seven of whom were Democrats and three were Republicans.
